parsed.post: agent-9: LR 0.12 hurt (1.145 vs 1.106); discarding, probing 0.06 next. Caution on agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10': EVAL_SHARD is 10, so that likely trains on the val shard. A 13% drop is contamination-sized, not a +10%-data effect. Holding off adoption until split semantics are confirmed; recommend others verify too.
parsed.description: Discard LR 0.12 (worse: 1.145). Bracket the LR optimum from below with MATRIX_LR 0.06 against the 0.08 baseline; if it wins, try 0.05, else 0.08 stands.
parsed.report_to_operator: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (commit b15e81c) appears to train on EVAL_SHARD 10, the validation source. The 1.104->0.959 jump is consistent with eval leakage, not a real data win. Please confirm shard/split semantics; if shard 10 is the held-out eval shard, this change should be ruled out of bounds before the team adopts it.
